args.description: dazed and dizzy after her guard breaks: stands slumped on wobbly bent knees, both arms hanging limp at her sides, head drooping and rolling slowly in a circle, eyes half closed, the whole body swaying from side to side on the spot, a seamless loop that ends exactly on the first pose. Only the character is drawn. The character stays at the same place in the frame (the game moves her), always facing right, seen from the side; keep her look, proportions and colours exactly. Only the character is drawn, with what she holds: no effect, no motion streak, no speed lines, no trail behind the limbs or the weapon, no glow, no energy, no projectile, no smoke, no dust, no ground, the whole body inside the picture. Every frame shows the arms, legs and weapon clearly in a crisp pose, never blurred.
args.subject_description: a young woman with a long black and red ponytail and red eyes, a closed black and red top covering the stomach, wide black and red sleeves, long black shorts over opaque black tights, black and red boots
args.initial_pose: fighting stance facing right, fists raised
